svg.title: cutoff_catalog_wide_appendix
svg.desc: Six panels compare full solid curves and fully-fitting dashed curves for WANDS and ESCI and three encoders. Green curves show persistent inclusion and rust curves show VI. Cutoffs are on a logarithmic horizontal axis. Full and fitting GTE curves overlap. The target-only curves describe separate counterfactual indexes, not Recall from one shared index.
